description: This PHP file contains functions for generating XML, HTML, and WML representations of filesystem information, including details about mounted filesystems such as size, used space, free space, and options. It is part of a system information script, likely used for monitoring or reporting system disk usage.

methods.name: xml_filesystems
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing filesystem data, including mount points, types, device names, usage percentages, free, used, and total sizes.

methods.name: html_filesystems
methods.description: Creates an HTML table displaying filesystem information with visual usage bars and totals.

methods.name: wml_filesystem
methods.description: Produces a WML card with filesystem details formatted for mobile devices.
